messages:
sam_support: FYI customer acme reports console shows a 350 USD promo credit banner but their API requests are still being billed. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/INC-2387 :thinking_face:

maria_acme: We're seeing the credit in the dashboard under org > billing, but our service key calls return 200 and meter events show no credit applied. Can someone confirm?

emma_billing: Can you paste the org_id and project_id? also which service key was used for the requests?

sam_support: Org: org_acme_42, Project: proj-legacy-17, Service key: rk_live_XXY123 (redacted). Customer says they merged projects last week.

raj_eng: quick check — are the metering events attached to proj-legacy-17 or a new merged project id?

sam_support: Running our metering query now, will paste raw rows.

sam_support: ```
SELECT project_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(credit_applied) as credits
FROM metering.events
WHERE org_id='org_acme_42' AND ts >= '2024-06-01'
GROUP BY project_id;
-- results:
proj-legacy-17 | tokens: 124k | credits: 0
proj-merged-99 | tokens: 0 | credits: 350
```

oncall_lead: Interesting — console shows credit on the org and displays on proj-merged-99 but customer's service key is still resolving to proj-legacy-17. Sounds like servicekey->project mapping didn't update on merge.

ops-bot: Deploy monitor: finished rollout of project-merge-mapper v1.3 at 2024-06-28T16:03Z :white_check_mark:

raj_eng: I think the bug is mapping cache invalidation after project-merge. We have a cache keyed by service_key that retains old project_id for 24h. If they merged but the mapping record moved, the cache never invalidated because the merge path skips the mapper change event.

emma_billing: Can we confirm whether the metering pipeline refunds or backfills credits if mapping changed after usage? Customer expects the last week to be deducted from promo credits.

raj_eng: Currently billing applies credits at aggregation time using project_id on events. Since events were attributed to proj-legacy-17, they won't auto-apply to proj-merged-99 credits. We can either re-emit events with corrected project_id (rehydrate) or move credits from proj-merged-99 to proj-legacy-17.

sam_support: Customer asks for a short-term fix while eng decides. They want immediate unbilled allowance so their production isn't impacted.

oncall_lead: Suggest issuing a manual invoice credit of 350 USD to proj-legacy-17 and schedule an internal follow-up to reprocess mapping. Raj — can you own a patch to invalidate the service_key cache on merge events?

raj_eng: Yep. I'll push a hotfix to invalidate mapping cache on merge events and open a job to reassign recent events for org_acme_42. ETA 4 hours for hotfix, 48 hours for full reprocess.

emma_billing: I'll create a refund/credit record now and mark it "manual:temporary" until reprocess completes. Sam, please confirm with customer that we applied a 350 USD temporary credit and we'll reconcile after reprocessing.

sam_support: Confirmed — applied manual credit 350 USD to proj-legacy-17 (ref# CR-2024-2387). Notified customer: "We've applied a temporary credit of $350 while we reprocess your recent usage; we'll follow up when it's reconciled." :thumbsup:

maria_acme: Thank you. Appreciate the quick response. Please let me know when the underlying mapping is fixed so we don't need the manual credit.

raj_eng: also logging action items: 1) hotfix cache invalidation (in review) 2) reprocess events for org_acme_42 3) postmortem + add test for merge path.

sam_support: I'll keep the ticket updated and set a reminder for follow-up in 72h. Closing loop in support ticket after reprocess.

emma_billing: tagging billing ops to watch reconciliation once reprocess finishes.```
